title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Rate Card Note: Weekly Allowance on the Care Increase of Re-Leveled Nights
content:
On a level-change segment of an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, longer re-levels carry the care increase on fewer nights than they re-level.

**Re-leveled nights.** The re-leveled nights of the segment are the nights of the stay's latest level-change adjustment credit.

**Allowance.** The billed re-leveled nights are counted by one of three methods: for a re-level of fourteen nights or more (14 or more), the care increase of one night in every seven re-leveled nights is not billed; for a re-level of seven to thirteen nights (7 to 13), the care increase of one night is not billed; for a shorter re-level (6 nights or fewer), the care increase is billed for every re-leveled night.

For a re-level of 14 nights or more, the nights whose care increase is not billed are the number of whole sevens in the re-leveled nights; a remainder of fewer than seven nights adds none. The allowance touches only the care increase: every re-leveled night still carries the nightly rate locked at booking.

## Billed re-leveled nights by length

| Re-leveled nights | Nights without the care increase | Billed re-leveled nights |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | 6 |
| 7 | 1 | 6 |
| 13 | 1 | 12 |
| 14 | 2 | 12 |
| 20 | 2 | 18 |
| 21 | 3 | 18 |
| 30 | 4 | 26 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A re-level of 9 nights from a locked rate of 239.00 to a stay type published at 284.00 carries the care increase of 45.00 on 8 nights: 9 times 239.00, that is 2,151.00, plus 8 times 45.00, that is 360.00, together 2,511.00.
